The '''2026 [[Courmayeur Ladies Open|Valle D'Aosta Ladies Open]]''' was a professional women's [[tennis]] tournament played on indoor [[hard court|hard courts]]. It was the second edition of the tournament and first as a [[WTA 125 tournaments|WTA 125]] event, which was part of the [[2026 WTA 125 Circuit]]. It was held at the Courmayeur Sport Center in [[Courmayeur]], Italy, from 26 October until 1 November, 2026.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.wtatennis.com/tournaments/1174/courmayeur-125/2026|title=Valle D'Aosta Ladies Open Overview|website=wtatennis.com}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.tennis.com/tournaments/valle-daosta-ladies-open/draws|title=WTA 125K Courmayeur, Italy|website=tennis.com}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.courmayeurmontblanc.it/event/wta125-ladies-open/|title=WTA 125 Valle d'Aosta Ladies Open|website=courmayeurmontblanc.it}}</ref> The first edition was held as a [[WTA 250 tournaments|WTA 250]] tournament in 2021.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/sport/tennis/2026/08/12/tennis-a-fine-ottobre-torna-il-valle-daosta-ladies-open_218a9afd-c80c-4c50-ab2a-fea580845025.html|title=Tennis, a fine ottobre torna il Valle d'Aosta Ladies Open|website=ansa.it}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.sbircialanotizia.it/articoli/2026/08/13/valle-aosta-ladies-open-d5ry6/|title=Valle d’Aosta Ladies Open, Courmayeur torna nel circuito WTA|website=sbircialanotizia.it}}</ref>
